motivation.primaryEvidence: Pyo and Jang, Revisiting the low-volatility anomaly in cryptocurrency markets, Finance Research Letters 97 (2026) 109851
motivation.designReason: The 2026 study reports a post-2017 low-volatility premium strongest around 2-3 month formation and 1-month holding. Trial 6 chooses one fixed 90-day formation window and one-month holding before any TheOldTrader result, with no momentum, return forecast, ML, or volatility threshold.

signal.decisionTiming: first UTC daily candle on the first day of each calendar month; ranking uses only closes strictly before the decision candle and execution uses that candle open
signal.volatilityEstimator: sample standard deviation of exact daily log returns over the prior 90 days, annualized by sqrt(365)
signal.selectionRule: select exactly the eligible asset with the lowest trailing annualized volatility; ties break lexicographically by product id

comparators: BTC-USD 15% buy-and-hold with identical entry/exit cost
equal 5% BTC-USD/ETH-USD/SOL-USD buy-and-hold for matched 15% total exposure with identical entry/exit cost
equal 15% BTC-USD/ETH-USD/SOL-USD buy-and-hold at the live 45% exposure cap
gate: candidate net return after frozen costs is positive over 2022-2025
candidate net return is positive in at least three of four calendar-year folds
candidate annualized Sharpe exceeds matched-exposure 15% equal-weight buy-and-hold
candidate maximum drawdown is no worse than matched-exposure 15% equal-weight buy-and-hold
every selected month has an exact 90-day daily lookback and all turnover is charged at 70 bps per traded dollar
development.failureRule: If the development gate fails, Trial 6 is recorded as failed and no formation-window, asset-count, exposure, or threshold rescue is permitted under lowvol-v1.

retrospectiveDiagnostic.purpose: diagnostic only; cannot authorize promotion because this period predates the Trial 6 freeze

requirements: at least 180 calendar days of post-freeze data beginning no earlier than 2026-08-19
positive net return after frozen costs
annualized Sharpe above matched-exposure equal-weight comparator
maximum drawdown no worse than matched-exposure equal-weight comparator
no data-provenance, exact-lookback, timestamp, or overwrite gate failure
report frozen v2 over the same prospective dates before any promotion proposal
